description: Evaluate whether an email address is suitable for a specified use case and return ALLOW, REVIEW or REJECT based on deliverability and risk evidence. USE WHEN: deciding suitability for outbound sales, account signup, transactional email, CRM import or lead qualification. DO NOT USE for domain-level risk/trust; use domain_risk_trust_decision. Does not probe the mailbox via SMTP, prove mailbox existence or guarantee delivery.

use_case.description: Intended sending context; adjusts how evidence such as role-account status and email authentication influences the suitability decision. Omit for a baseline decision without contextual adjustments.
use_case.title: Use Case

name: email_suitability_decision

checks.description: Per-signal check results keyed by check name: syntax, domain, mx, spf, dmarc, disposable, role_account. Each value is a machine-readable result string (e.g. 'syntax:valid', 'mx:found', 'spf:pass', 'disposable:no'). Partial when a DNS lookup is unavailable.

dmarc.description: Result of the DMARC record validation check.

domain.description: Result of the email domain validation check.

mx.description: Result of the MX record lookup check.

spf.description: Result of the SPF record validation check.

syntax.description: Result of the email syntax validation check.

confidence.description: Confidence in the suitability decision based on the available evidence and decision context; incomplete evidence can reduce confidence.

decision.description: Contextual suitability decision (ALLOW/REVIEW/REJECT) derived from deliverability and risk evidence; use_case can adjust how observed signals affect the resulting decision.

deliverability_score.description: Deliverability score from 0 to 100 derived from observed email and domain evidence; favorable signals increase the score and risk or missing-deliverability signals can reduce it.

mx_found.description: Backward-compatible MX result; null means lookup unavailable.

reasons.description: Machine-readable reason codes explaining the decision and corresponding to observed checks.

risk_level.description: Risk classification derived from observed evidence and deliverability score; some risk signals can independently raise the resulting risk level.

use_case.description: The validated use case echoed from the input; null when omitted. Affects contextual decision adjustments such as role-account tolerance and SPF/DMARC weighting.

valid.description: Backward-compatible validity summary based on deliverability score >= 60. Does not prove mailbox existence or delivery.

title: Email Suitability Decision
